index: Nasdaq Stockholm Large Cap + Mid Cap
source_kind: APPROXIMATION -- market-cap cut, not index membership
approximation_rule: Yahoo equity screener for exchange STO with intraday market cap > SEK 1,658,399,963, i.e. Nasdaq's own Mid Cap floor of EUR 150,000,000 converted at EUR/SEK 11.0560.
approximation_caveat: Segment membership is reviewed by Nasdaq annually; a live market-cap cut therefore disagrees with the official segment at the margins, and it does not separate the Main Market from First North. Nasdaq's official segment file is behind a login on indexes.nasdaqomx.com.
isin_note: No free source checked carries ISIN for these venues; a guessed ISIN would silently merge two companies in dedup. Left empty.
